title: Jeevan Dhaara
overview: Mr. Shrivastav abandons his family for a life of hermitage.  His family struggles to carry on financially in his absence, with two daughters: Sangeeta and Geeta forced to carry the burden of employment, while their brother Ashok gambles their earnings away.
